name: Liberator Variants
description: Five standalone arsenal weapons on the AR-23 Liberator's model, each showing one part of a weapon of your own: a gold recolour, a cube mesh from an OBJ file, animations of its own, a projectile and damage type of its own with blue effects and the Sickle's shot, and a whole carbine from a glTF model with its own textures. HellForge builds them from your game copy (hellforge-data.json). Source in src/.
